test: Offline reference render with deterministic built-in processors
required_observation: Expected length, alignment and samples/tolerance; repeatability with fixed seeds. Third-party non-determinism is separately characterized.

test: 30-minute mixed audio/MIDI session at 48 kHz; sweep 64/128/256-frame buffers on actual devices
required_observation: Dropouts, callback maxima/percentiles, RAM/GPU/CPU and disk behavior reported by configuration. A proposed 64-playback/8-recording fixture is a stress target, not a published minimum spec.

test: UI reload, AI crash and visual restart during playback
required_observation: No audio dependency on these workers. Engine crash is a distinct case: shell survives and offers a verified checkpoint, but playback necessarily stops.

test: Hung scan, crashing plugin and missing binary/version
required_observation: Quarantine/recovery behavior is explicit. No false guarantee of uninterrupted audio before processing isolation is implemented.

test: Hot unplug, Bluetooth/default-device switch, sample-rate mismatch and MIDI disconnect
required_observation: Clear state and recovery, no stuck notes, no unintended feedback, known monitoring policy.

test: Kill process at each save stage; disk full; truncated media; corrupt project/model; path traversal archive
required_observation: Previous checkpoint is recoverable; no successful-save signal before commit; rejected untrusted imports and safe staged cleanup.

test: Automation/cue timing and native plugin editors across platforms
required_observation: Measured sample/beat alignment, parameter state restore, focus, DPI, resize, keyboard and teardown behavior.

test: AI job storms, cancellation, stale suggestions, thermal or GPU memory pressure
required_observation: Admission control works; resources release; performance mode reduces background load; generated changes require acceptance.

test: Visual/FFmpeg/AI worker timeout or malformed shader/model input
required_observation: Failure remains isolated as far as the tested OS/GPU permits; audio does not wait; export errors are explicit.

test: Clean-machine installation, offline launch, signed update and rollback/recovery
required_observation: No developer toolchain required; correct workers/runtimes present; no test automation server exposed in release builds.
Every runtime artifact has an owner, pinned version, licence, provenance and an update path. No “unknown” components in the release manifest.
Users complete record/compose/edit/mix/export and gesture/AI acceptance tasks without losing intent or being forced through generation.
